modules.title: Probability and Statistics
modules.overview: Training in foundational uncertainty, randomness, and statistical evidence evaluation.

lessons.title: Randomness, uncertainty, and distributions
lessons.purpose: Establish a rigorous mental model for treating randomness as structured distributions rather than noise.
lessons.whyItMatters: Without defining the distribution, point estimates are unreliable.

lessons.title: Sampling, estimation, and standard error
lessons.purpose: Understand how sample properties map to population parameters under uncertainty.
lessons.whyItMatters: Differentiates signal from sample variation.

lessons.title: Hypothesis testing and statistical evidence
lessons.purpose: Evaluate whether data contradicts a null assumption rigorously.
lessons.whyItMatters: Prevents false discovery and validates effect sizes.

lessons.title: Regression as controlled comparison
lessons.purpose: Use regression mechanics to control for observable confounders.
lessons.whyItMatters: Forms the basis for all predictive and causal modeling.

completedEvidence.title: Quant/options Lesson 1
completedEvidence.proves: Understanding of return distribution and standard error.

modules.title: Data Engineering and Infrastructure
modules.overview: Building reproducible, observable pipelines to support reliable analytical evidence.

lessons.title: Data is produced, not found
lessons.purpose: Trace analytical data back to the telemetry that generated it.
lessons.whyItMatters: Ignorance of the data generating process causes hidden bias.

lessons.title: Pipelines, schemas, and validation
lessons.purpose: Design robust data ingestion with strict types.
lessons.whyItMatters: Silent data failures corrupt all downstream models.

lessons.title: ETL/ELT and reproducibility
lessons.purpose: Build idempotent analytical environments.
lessons.whyItMatters: If it cannot be reproduced from scratch, it is not evidence.

lessons.title: Observability and data quality
lessons.purpose: Establish tests to catch data drift.
lessons.whyItMatters: Data decays rapidly over time without active monitoring.

lessons.title: Infrastructure as guardrails
lessons.purpose: Use system design to limit degrees of freedom.
lessons.whyItMatters: Structure prevents analysts from hacking ad-hoc answers.

modules.title: Machine Learning
modules.overview: Evaluation, validation, and diagnostic pressure testing of predictive models.

lessons.title: Prediction versus explanation
lessons.purpose: Differentiate models built for predictive accuracy from models built for causal interpretation.
lessons.whyItMatters: Prevents using a black-box predictor to make major policy decisions.

lessons.title: Train/test splits and leakage
lessons.purpose: Enforce strict boundaries between training data and validation evidence.
lessons.whyItMatters: Data leakage invalidates all downstream metrics.

lessons.title: Bias-variance tradeoff
lessons.purpose: Diagnose underfitting and overfitting structurally.
lessons.whyItMatters: Dictates model complexity and regularizer choice.

lessons.title: Model evaluation and error analysis
lessons.purpose: Move beyond aggregate metrics by inspecting specific failure modes.
lessons.whyItMatters: Overall accuracy hides catastrophic specific errors.

lessons.title: Interpretability and deployment limits
lessons.purpose: Define the operational envelope and feature attributions of the model.
lessons.whyItMatters: Allows humans to oversee and audit automated predictions.

modules.title: Causal Inference
modules.overview: Rigorous identification of causal effects versus spurious correlations using causal models.

lessons.title: Correlation versus causation
lessons.purpose: Formally separate observational correlation from actual intervention.
lessons.whyItMatters: Intervening on a proxy does not change the outcome.

lessons.title: DAGs and identification
lessons.purpose: Draw explicit assumptions to identify valid backdoor adjustment sets.
lessons.whyItMatters: Makes assumptions explicit, auditable, and falsifiable.

lessons.title: Confounding, selection, and colliders
lessons.purpose: Identify paths that induce spurious non-causal associations.
lessons.whyItMatters: Controlling for a collider actively creates bias.

lessons.title: ITT versus treatment-on-treated
lessons.purpose: Distinguish the effect of offering treatment from actually taking it.
lessons.whyItMatters: Solves real-world non-compliance in field experiments.

lessons.title: Difference-in-differences and experiments
lessons.purpose: Exploit natural experiments when randomization is impossible.
lessons.whyItMatters: Provides causal leverage on historical observational data.

completedEvidence.title: AI Writing Assistance DAG / SAP
completedEvidence.proves: distinguish ITT/offered-access effect Z -> Y from actual-use effect D -> Y

modules.title: LLMs, Agents, and RAG
modules.overview: Designing, evaluating, and bounding large language models and agentic workflows.

lessons.title: LLMs as interfaces, not oracles
lessons.purpose: Frame language models as probabilistic text generators.
lessons.whyItMatters: Treating LLMs as knowledge bases causes hallucinations.

lessons.title: Retrieval and context management
lessons.purpose: Inject verifiable facts into LLM context windows.
lessons.whyItMatters: Separates world knowledge from language syntax.

lessons.title: Agent roles and workflow boundaries
lessons.purpose: Enforce strict single-responsibility prompts.
lessons.whyItMatters: Agents with too much agency collapse into endless loops.

lessons.title: Evaluation, hallucination, and traceability
lessons.purpose: Measure agent performance systematically.
lessons.whyItMatters: Vibes-based evaluation fails at scale.

lessons.title: Local-first AI workflows
lessons.purpose: Design systems that work without internet access.
lessons.whyItMatters: Ensures data privacy and system resilience.

modules.title: Experimental Design and Metrics
modules.overview: Designing valid experiments and establishing non-perverse metric frameworks.

lessons.title: Metrics are proxies, not values
lessons.purpose: Differentiate what you care about from what you measure.
lessons.whyItMatters: Optimizing the wrong proxy destroys the underlying value.

lessons.title: Treatment assignment and experiment validity
lessons.purpose: Structure valid randomized control trials.
lessons.whyItMatters: Flawed randomization creates biased causal estimates.

lessons.title: Power, sample size, and detectable effects
lessons.purpose: Calculate exactly how much data is needed to detect an effect.
lessons.whyItMatters: Underpowered experiments waste time and yield false negatives.

lessons.title: Guardrail metrics and unintended incentives
lessons.purpose: Define metrics to prevent unintended damage.
lessons.whyItMatters: Success in one metric often cannibalizes another.

modules.title: Labor Economics and Human Capital
modules.overview: Understanding core dynamics of labor markets, signals, and human capital accumulation.

lessons.title: Human capital versus signaling
lessons.purpose: Separate actual skill from credential signals.
lessons.whyItMatters: Determines how employers value candidates.

lessons.title: Labor supply and incentives
lessons.purpose: Understand how compensation shapes effort.
lessons.whyItMatters: Misaligned incentives cause major retention issues.

modules.title: Industrial Organization and Platforms
modules.overview: Analyzing network effects, competitive moats, and platform economics.

lessons.title: Market power and concentration
lessons.purpose: Identify clear monopolies and pricing power.
lessons.whyItMatters: Explains long-term margin sustainability.

lessons.title: Multi-sided platforms
lessons.purpose: Analyze business models connecting distinct user groups.
lessons.whyItMatters: Network effects are the strongest defensible moat in tech.

modules.title: Quantitative Finance and Options
modules.overview: Analyzing market mechanics, risk regimes, and option pricing structures.

lessons.title: Observed return is not alpha
lessons.purpose: Decompose portfolio returns into risk factors.
lessons.whyItMatters: Prevents confusing leveraged beta with actual skill.

lessons.title: Risk factors and factor exposure
lessons.purpose: Measure exposure to hidden hidden risks.
lessons.whyItMatters: Hidden exposures cause catastrophic correlated failures.

lessons.title: Sharpe ratios, drawdowns, and transaction costs
lessons.purpose: Evaluate trading strategies rigorously.
lessons.whyItMatters: Transaction costs destroy paper-only strategies.

lessons.title: Options as volatility, convexity, time, and skew instruments
lessons.purpose: Treat options as multi-dimensional risk instruments.
lessons.whyItMatters: Options are not just directional bets; they price variance.

lessons.title: Backtesting and regime risk
lessons.purpose: Simulate strategies across changing market conditions.
lessons.whyItMatters: Strategies that work in bull markets blow up in regimes shifts.

completedEvidence.title: Quant/options Lesson 1
completedEvidence.proves: observed return is not automatically alpha; options are not just directional bets

modules.title: Entrepreneurship and Venture Strategy
modules.overview: Evaluating start-up viability, risk, and venture capital mechanics.

lessons.title: Venture capital as an asset class
lessons.purpose: Understand the power law economics of early-stage investing.
lessons.whyItMatters: Explains why VCs only fund extreme high-variance bets.

lessons.title: Founder-market fit and moats
lessons.purpose: Evaluate startup defensibility before scale.
lessons.whyItMatters: Great technology fails without long-term defensibility.

modules.title: Responsible AI and Governance
modules.overview: Translating ethical principles into auditable institutional risk frameworks.

lessons.title: Risk, accountability, and model limits
lessons.purpose: Define who is responsible for automated failure.
lessons.whyItMatters: Algorithms cannot hold legal or moral liability.

lessons.title: Algorithmic impact assessment
lessons.purpose: Systematically map harms before deployment.
lessons.whyItMatters: Prevents shipping models that cause discriminatory harm.

lessons.title: Human oversight and documentation
lessons.purpose: Design human-in-the-loop fallback systems.
lessons.whyItMatters: Ensures exceptions can be handled safely.

lessons.title: Bias, fairness, and institutional context
lessons.purpose: Translate mathematical fairness metrics to policy.
lessons.whyItMatters: Fairness definitions often mutually contradict in practice.

modules.title: Technical Communication and Portfolio
modules.overview: Converting analytical outputs into legible, compelling evidence for external review.

lessons.title: Translating analysis into public evidence
lessons.purpose: Convert complex code into legible portfolio artifacts.
lessons.whyItMatters: Code that nobody can read has no impact.

lessons.title: Writing for reviewers and stakeholders
lessons.purpose: Structure documents for extreme scannability.
lessons.whyItMatters: Stakeholders don't read paragraphs; they scan structure.

lessons.title: Case studies, artifacts, and proof
lessons.purpose: Bundle isolated artifacts into cohesive case studies.
lessons.whyItMatters: Narrative proves the ability to execute end-to-end.

lessons.title: Resume/interview translation
lessons.purpose: Extract portfolio proof into high-density resume bullets.
lessons.whyItMatters: Secures actual career leverage from intellectual effort.

modules.title: Public Policy and Governance
modules.overview: Designing interventions in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

lessons.title: Policy analysis and trade-offs
lessons.purpose: Evaluate complex interventions mathematically and ethically.
lessons.whyItMatters: No policy is perfect; all involve difficult trade-offs.

lessons.title: Market failures and intervention
lessons.purpose: Identify exactly why a market fails before intervening.
lessons.whyItMatters: Misdiagnosed market failures lead to worse policy outcomes.

modules.title: Capstone Integration
modules.overview: Synthesizing methodologies into a final, comprehensive cohesive portfolio artifact.

lessons.title: Problem framing
lessons.purpose: Define the core analytical thesis for the final project.
lessons.whyItMatters: Poor framing wastes months of execution time.

lessons.title: Evidence architecture
lessons.purpose: Map the dependencies between all required artifacts.
lessons.whyItMatters: Ensures the final portfolio is cohesive, not just a random collection.

lessons.title: Cross-module synthesis
lessons.purpose: Combine causal, predictive, and economic methodologies.
lessons.whyItMatters: Real-world problems don't fit into single academic disciplines.

lessons.title: Final artifact loop
lessons.purpose: Execute the core implementation.
lessons.whyItMatters: Closes the loop from theory to production evidence.

lessons.title: Portfolio presentation
lessons.purpose: Package the system for public stakeholder review.
lessons.whyItMatters: The final proof of competency.
